Name: Duck Fabric
Author: Crafterbuddy
Description:
Adds Duck Fabric, an artisan good made from duck feathers.
Processed using a loom.

The fact that duck feathers and rabbit feet couldn't be processed into artisan goods annoyed me, and they were clogging up my Automate factories.
I made this mod (and the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14039]Rabbit's Foot Lucky Oil[/url] mod) to fix it.
